title: Moab's Plea and Judgment

questions.question: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela, by way of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:1 (ESV): "by way of the desert," (Text says "wilderness" in some versions, ESV "desert" or "wilderness"? ESV: "Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela, by way of the desert, to the mount of the daughter of Zion." Checking ESV text: "from Sela, by way of the wilderness,". Wait, KJV says wilderness. ESV says wilderness. Let me check standard ESV again. "Send the lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela, by way of the wilderness,". Correct answer should be Wilderness. But Sela is in the desert. Let's check specific word. "Wilderness".

questions.question: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land... to the mount of the daughter of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:1 (ESV): "to the mount of the daughter of Zion."

questions.question: Like fleeing birds, like a scattered nest, so are the daughters of Moab at the fords of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:2 (ESV): "at the fords of the Arnon."

questions.question: Give counsel; grant justice; make your shadow like night at the height of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:3 (ESV): "make your shadow like night at the height of noon;"

questions.question: Hide the outcasts; do not betray the what?
Let the outcasts of Moab sojourn among you; be a shelter to them from the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:4 (ESV): "be a shelter to them from the destroyer."

questions.question: When the oppressor is no more, and destruction has ceased... then a throne will be established in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:5 (ESV): "then a throne will be established in steadfast love,"

questions.question: And on it will sit in faithfulness in the tent of whom one who judges and seeks justice?
We have heard of the pride of Moab—how proud he is!—of his arrogance, his pride, and his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:6 (ESV): "of his arrogance, his pride, and his insolence;"

questions.question: Therefore let Moab wail for Moab, let everyone wail. Mourn, utterly stricken, for the raisin cakes of where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:7 (ESV): "for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth."

questions.question: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of where?
The lords of the nations have struck down its branches, which reached to Jazer and strayed to the what?
Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I drench you with my tears, O Heshbon and whom?
For over your summer fruit and your harvest the what has fallen?
I have put an end to the shouting. My inner parts rumble for Moab like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:11 (ESV): "My inner parts rumble for Moab like a harp,"

questions.question: In three years, like the years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will be brought into contempt... and those who survive will be very few and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 16:14 (ESV): "will be very few and feeble."

key_verse_text: Then a throne will be established in steadfast love, and on it will sit in faithfulness in the tent of David one who judges and seeks justice and is swift to do righteousness.
